text:
elaine: opened PR #842 to standardize retry/error microcopy across SDK snippets (py/js/go). aiming to land before the migration cutover next week.

sam: thanks! can you call out the exact strings we're changing?

elaine: yes — main changes: replace 'retrying...' with 'retry attempt {n} of {max}', unify transient vs permanent error wording, and make guidance example show exponential backoff.

olivia: fyi this affects the examples in the 'rate-limits' and 'errors' pages. i can scan for occurrences.

jun: do we also update generated SDK clients or only docs snippets?

elaine: docs first. we'll open followups for gen-clients if needed. plan: land docs PR, then ship a small patch release if client text needs sync.

mike: quick suggestion — in JS snippet prefer `attempt` over `n` to be clearer.

elaine: good call. updated PR to use `attempt`.

olivia: small nit — the python example uses `sleep(2 ** n)`, should be `sleep(base * 2 ** (attempt - 1))` so base is configurable.

elaine: updated. added a one-line explanation beneath the snippet.

sam: can we add a short note in the migration guide about 'param casing' change interacting with error field names? one customer already asked.

elaine: yes — adding a checklist item: verify error field names in integrations (snake_case -> lowerCamel).

jun: i'll run a quick grep across the repo for the old phrasing and list links.

docs-bot: PR #842 opened by elaine on main; reviewers requested: olivia, sam; merge checks pending.

mike: reviewers: i can take the JS pass tomorrow morning.

olivia: i'll sweep the docs pages this afternoon. posting a short diff summary here after. :eyes:

elaine: thanks all. timeline: aim to merge by EOD Wed, ship migration note in next-day changelog. if blockers, ping me and we'll reprioritize. :shipit:

sam: noted. i'll add an example entry to the migration guide and link to the PR.

jun: grep results: 6 occurrences of 'retrying' in docs, 2 in examples that will be changed by this PR. putting links in the PR description.

elaine: perfect — closing loop. after merge i'll open a follow-up issue to track generated-client syncs and file a short RFC if we need to change structured error shapes.

docs-bot: PR #842 merged by olivia (checks passed).
